Balanced: + heavy rain, sudden temperature change
Sensitive: + unusual days vs. the last 30 days, card only

About.Title: About PulseMonitor
About.Tagline: Lightweight system monitor for the Windows 11 taskbar
About.InspiredRest: (MIT, © zhongyang219) — thank you. PulseMonitor is written from scratch; no code was taken from it.
About.Data.OpenMeteo: — weather forecast and location search. License:
About.Data.Osm: contributors (Nominatim) — neighbourhood and village search. License:
About.Data.GeoNames: — village, town and district names (via Open-Meteo). License:
About.Data.Ipify: — external IP address; only while the “External IP” item is on.
About.Privacy: Settings, traffic history and cache are kept only on this computer. The program connects to Open-Meteo for the forecast while weather is on, to Open-Meteo and OpenStreetMap when you search for a location, to ipify while “External IP” is on, to the server you chose while “Ping” is on, and to GitHub once a day while update checks are on (only the latest version number is read). No data is sent anywhere else; there are no accounts, ads or usage tracking.
